question: Q-W-S2-D4
text: Backordered order lines in 2015 by salesperson and stock group; identify the salesperson with the most.
interpretation: Backordered order lines in calendar 2015 by salesperson and stock group. salesperson_total_lines counts each line once (deduplicated across groups); is_top_salesperson marks the salesperson with the most lines (ties: name).
assemble: WITH p AS (SELECT salesperson, total_lines FROM people WHERE total_lines IS NOT NULL), top_sp AS (SELECT salesperson FROM p ORDER BY total_lines DESC, salesperson LIMIT 1) SELECT g.salesperson, g.stock_group_name, g.backordered_lines, p.total_lines AS salesperson_total_lines, g.salesperson = t.salesperson AS is_top_salesperson FROM groups g JOIN p ON p.salesperson = g.salesperson CROSS JOIN top_sp t WHERE g.backordered_lines IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.salesperson, g.stock_group_name
note: salesperson_total_lines comes from a query without Stock Group, which Tableau answers without the bridge, so each backordered line counts once.
